title: Data Actions: Bridging Insights to CRM Execution

steps.prompt: A Streaming Insight flags VIP churn risk above 85%. Retention must start in core CRM within minutes — without a custom polling service. How should Data 360 invoke the downstream workflow?

options.label: Configure a Data Action targeting a Platform Event or Flow when the threshold condition fires
options.rationale: Data Actions trigger near-real-time events or Salesforce Flows directly from Streaming Insights without requiring external middleware or polling.

options.label: Schedule a frequent Apex Queueable job polling the Data Cloud SQL Query API for updated scores
options.distractorAntipattern: Polling Data Cloud Query API from Apex wastes API calls, adds latency, and risks rate-limit exceptions.
options.rationale: Continuous polling from Apex consumes API quotas, adds latency, and creates tight coupling instead of event-driven execution.

options.label: Publish segment memberships to an Amazon S3 target and trigger an external webhook to CRM
options.distractorAntipattern: S3 segment activation introduces file export latency and requires external orchestration middleware.
options.rationale: File-based cloud storage activation introduces significant batch egress latency and violates the requirement for direct, near-real-time CRM invocation.
